name: frame_broll
description: Frame a landscape clip on a vertical timeline (b-roll) in one call, never a blind centre crop: track follows its moving subject with a keyframed crop; card insets the whole frame on paper with corner brackets and a 'Footage: <source>' credit, above the captions; auto (default) tracks one clear subject the captions stay clear of, else cards (text off the subject). A human edit since the read is refused. Answers with a sheet of the clip's range.

input.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

output.description: {id, mode (track, card or none), why?, keys? (crop keys), found? (frames with the subject), card? (the overlay's id), path (the sheet)}. detail adds the crop width and the card's box.

params.name: project
params.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

params.name: item
params.description: The b-roll clip's item id (a video on an upper track).

params.name: mode
params.description: auto: track one clear moving subject, else card. track: a crop that follows the subject. card: the whole frame inset.

params.name: source
params.description: Where the footage is from, for the card's credit: 'PhoneBot project video' gives 'Footage: PhoneBot project video'.

params.name: detail
params.description: Also answer the crop width and the card's box.
